entities.name: Juan Lozano y Lozano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Juan Lozano, O.E.S.A. was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Plasencia (1677–1679),
Archbishop of Palermo (1669–1677),
Bishop of Mazara del Vallo (1656–1669), and 
Bishop of Tropea (1646–1656).
